title: Pure Fortune Lady
summary: Pure Fortune Lady Synchro beatdown and draw engine build, starring Carly Carmine's variable-Level Spellcasters alongside staples. The monsters adjust their Levels dynamically to trigger devastating search, draw, and removal effects, culminating in persistent Level 7 and 8 Synchro boss control.

summary.title: Starters & Level Manipulation
points: Fortune Lady Past is the core Level 1 Tuner; it targets a Fortune Lady you control, banishing Spellcasters from hand, field, or GY to raise or lower that monster's Level by 1 per banished monster.

Fortune Vision searches any Fortune Lady card upon activation, makes your monsters battle-immune for a turn if a monster is banished by effect, and negates damage once if the opponent banishes a card.
Fortune Lady Light Special Summons a Fortune Lady monster directly from the Deck with a different name whenever it leaves the field by card effect (including when banished by Past).
Fortune Lady Calling Special Summons a Fortune Lady with a different name from your Deck while you control any Fortune Lady, locking your Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters.

summary.title: Opening: Fortune Vision + Fortune Lady Past
steps: Activate Fortune Vision to search Fortune Lady Light from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Fortune Lady Past, then activate Fortune Lady Calling to Special Summon Fortune Lady Light from your Deck.
Activate Past's effect targeting Light, banishing Fortune Lady Light from the field to increase Past's Level to 2.
Light's effect triggers upon being banished by card effect, Special Summoning Fortune Lady Water directly from the Deck.
Water triggers upon summon while you control another Fortune Lady, immediately drawing 2 cards.
Synchro Summon Fortune Lady Every using Level 3 Tuner Past (or boosted via Time Passage) and Level 4 Water.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Fortune Lady Every gains 400 ATK/DEF each Standby Phase as its Level increases, non-target banishes an opponent's face-up monster during their End Phase or your Standby Phase, and revives itself from the GY by banishing another Spellcaster.

Draco Berserker of the Tenyi is accessed through high-Level Synchro tuning (such as Past and Fortune Lady Dark), banishing a monster whose effect the opponent activates and attacking twice after it destroys a monster by battle.
Fortune Lady Fire destroys 1 face-up monster the opponent controls and inflicts damage equal to its ATK whenever it is Special Summoned in Attack Position by a Fortune Lady card effect.
Fortune Lady Wind destroys opponent Spells and Traps up to the number of face-up Fortune Lady monsters you control upon Normal Summon.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fortune's Future targets 1 of your banished Fortune Lady monsters, returning it to the GY to draw 2 cards.
Fortune Lady Rewind is a Normal Trap that Special Summons any number of your banished Fortune Lady monsters with different names to the field, returning them to the Deck during the End Phase.
Time Passage is a Quick-Play Spell that temporarily increases a Fortune Lady monster's Level by 3, setting up higher-tier Synchro Summons or boosting ATK in battle.
